description:
Chunk.encode/1 writes whatever list it is handed, building directory entries in argument order, without checking that versions ascend or that they are unique. Every reader assumes both: the directory is binary-searched, and read_from_version/3 walks it forward.

A consolidator assembling a pack from a bad selection would therefore write a corrupt object silently, and it would surface much later as a replay anomaly far from its cause.

Add the validation to encode/1. Confirm no existing test depends on passing unsorted or duplicated input.
title: Chunk.encode/1 rejects unordered or duplicate versions
